title: 第一章 师傅
content_zh:
李火旺举起手中的捣药杆，百无聊赖了的一下一下砸在捣药罐里，把里面夹杂着淤泥的流光青石慢慢碾磨成粉末。
虽然这溶洞潮湿寒冷，少年身上也只穿着一件粗粝布衣。但是他却满脸不在乎，似乎并没有把这一切放在眼里。
洞内不止他一个人，同样还有其他年龄相仿的男男女女，同样束发，同样的粗布麻绳。
他们与李火旺唯一不同的就是，身体上都有明显的外在缺陷，其中有白化病也有小儿麻痹。
各种先天后天的身体畸形都可以在这里找到，不大的料房溶洞内仿佛一座畸形博物馆。
这些人的工作跟李火旺的一样都是捣东西，只是捣的东西不同，有金石也有药物，但是很显然有些人并不安心工作。
“啊！”一声女人的惊恐尖叫，引得所有人看去。
只见在溶洞的一旁，一位兔唇的胖少年脸上露出猥琐的笑容，企图把一位白化病少女拉进自己的怀里。
“俺就弄一下，保证就一下，嘿嘿嘿~”
李火旺无视这些嘈杂，闭上眼睛继续一下一下地干自己的活。
听着耳边的女人哭声越来越凄惨，恼火的李火旺暗暗地骂了一句，单手拎起石制的药罐站了起来。
“哆”石头跟骨头撞击在一起，发出一声闷响。
头破血流的裂唇胖子一屁股坐在地上愣住了，显然是被这一下砸懵了，过了两秒后，他表情扭曲痛苦捂着自己伤口干嚎起来。
逃脱了被玷污命运的白发白肤的少女，捂着自己的衣服畏惧的躲在李火旺的身后。
“俺告诉你！你完撩，你知道俺是师傅什么仁吗？让他老人家知道撩，他弄死你！”裂唇胖子表情异常愤怒地威胁到。
“他算个什么东西，他连屁都不是！！”李火旺这话一出，惊骇全场鸦雀无声。
在场的其他人从来没有想到面前这个男人居然敢说出这样的。
看着面前这些所谓的师兄师弟们的神色，李火旺深吸一口气，把心中的怒火压制下来。
“我这是怎么了，怎么跟这些东西生气，自己的性格明明不是这么张扬才对，不能让这些东西影响自己的性格，刚刚的我不是真正的我，冷静冷静。”
就在李火旺还在平息自己的心情之时，就听到门口有人喊他。

“李师弟，王师妹，师傅唤你等过去。”喊话的高个青年明显跟李火旺的地位不一样的，身上穿是一件青色道袍。
虽然那道袍看起来很旧了，袖口都洗的发白，可这远比李火旺身上的破麻布好上不知道多少倍。
此人单手环抱一把马尾拂尘，看着面前的后辈们眼中带着一丝傲慢。
见年轻道士出现，那位头破血流的胖子顿时露出辛灾乐货的表情。“哈哈！你完撩！！今天到你撩。”
但是李火旺完全无视他，转身就要跟着一位嘴巴歪斜流着口水的女人向着门口走去，女人脸色蜡白看起很的不健康。
刚走两步却发现有人在拽自己的衣袖，拉住不让他走。李火旺回头发现是那位被自己救的白化病少女。
眼泪汪汪的她不断摇头，眼中充满着恐惧。
冷漠的李火旺不为所动，用力一摔袖子，大步流星向前走去。
从料房出来是一个更大的溶洞，溶洞洞壁上还有不少跟料房一样的溶洞充当其他用途，看那坑坑洼洼的样子，当初建造这地方的人手艺明显不怎么样。
整个溶洞很大，大大小小的隧道四通八达，犹如放大版的蚁穴。
一块块腐朽的桃木被钉在每一个小溶洞结上面，上面用入木三分的力道刻下了每个洞窟的名字，灵宫殿，老律堂，庆祖殿、四御殿。
一个天然形成的溶洞居然被捯饬得俨然一副道馆的样子。
就在两人顺着溶洞继续往前走着时，旁边的歪嘴女人从口袋里掏出一块黑乎乎的东西来，忽然递到李火旺的面前，用那痴痴呆呆的声音说道：“吃.....稀糖吗？”
李火旺眉头微微一皱，似乎知道对方的憨傻，不耐烦的过来直接塞进自己的衣袖内。
见李火旺接过去，她也又从兜里掏出一块塞进自己嘴里，傻呵呵的继续说道：“师傅好.....跟师傅有糖吃....”
对此李火旺并没有打算说什么，两人继续走着，就这样走了差不多一刻钟左右，一座古香古色，通体发黑的高大炼丹炉出现在他的面前。
冒着青烟的炉鼎直戳洞顶，丹炉巨大看起来就像一座金属小山。
由远到近地看着那丹炉逐渐变大，最终丹炉的阴影直接淹没过了自己，这让李火旺倍感压抑。
让他感到压抑的除了那巨大的五层丹炉外，还有在丹炉面前的一道背影。
从背面看他身穿青蓝色道袍，簪发戴冠，两鬓白发，看起来十分的仙风道骨。

盘坐在地上的他似乎也在做着之前跟李火旺相同的事情，拿到捣药杆一下一下的捣着，只是他手中的捣药杆明显大上很多，看起来像一根巨柱。
随着一起一落，金石撞击之声在溶洞内不断的回荡。
“师……师傅！”斜嘴女人笨拙的用右手掐住左手的拇指，左手的四个指头放在右手的指头上面，把双手放在胸口对着那背影作揖，眼中满是敬意。
她一开口，那刺耳的撞击声便停了下来。
背影一转身，虽然心中早有准备可李火旺的瞳孔还是被惊的微微一缩。
道士的正面跟背面截然不同，从背面看仙风道骨，可从正面看，那却是一位恶心的癞子头老头，地包天的嘴里零星的几颗黄牙就这么暴露在空气中。
“来了?好徒儿，让我好等。”
脏兮兮的道袍一挥，老道士腾空而起，单手抓住那歪嘴女人的脖子退了回去。
还没等那痴傻的女人开口再说上半句话，瞬间就被扔进半人高的石瓮中，下一刻，表情狰狞的师傅双手拳头大小的石头捣药杆，对着她脑袋重重的砸了下去。
随着惨叫声戛然而止，从那石瓮中传来，某种脚踩入烂泥的吧唧声。
这还不算完，之前的撞击再次回荡，伴随着捣药杆高高抬起又重重的落下，女人的身体每一块地方都落得跟脑袋一样的结局。
每敲一下，呼吸急促的李火旺的右脸皮肉也跟随着牵动般猛抖了一下。
肉渣跟血抹溅到老道士的脸上跟身上，但是他不为所动表情亢奋的按照某种旋律念着什么。
“丁丑延我寿，丁亥护我魂，甲子护我身，甲戌保我形，甲申固我命，甲午守我魂，甲辰真我灵！”
当彻底捣烂成糜后，他单手举起那重达几百斤的石翁，把亲手捣出来的一摊烂泥全部倒进面前的炼丹炉里，紧接着表情极度亢奋的双手向着空中猛地一举。
“起炉，炼丹！”
两位化着夸张腮红的道童从阴影中走出，一边扇风一边向着丹炉内倒着各种佐料，其中有各种金石粉末也有不少活着蠕动的东西。
没过一会，一种诡异的浓郁香气在空中弥漫。
此时此刻，那位癞子头师傅闭上眼睛深深地吸了一口气后，抚着自己下巴上没有几根胡须，肮脏丑陋的脸上露出满意的表情。
当他缓缓睁开眼睛，把双手背在身后，转头向着李火旺看去。“听说你称呼本道爷是个屁？可有这事啊？”

刹那间，四周的空气仿佛凝固了起来。
看着面前这位杀人不眨眼所谓的师傅，李火旺不为所动，缓缓闭上眼睛平息自己有些急促呼吸，心中默念：“你们骗不了我，这都是假的，都是假的。”
“说话！哑巴么?嗯？！”伴随着师傅的脚步声音越来越近了，他身上混杂着血腥味的恶臭，如同一堵墙般扑鼻而来。
颤抖的李火旺猛地咬紧牙关，用上全身的力气猛地用力一睁眼。
刚刚还昏暗充满压抑的洞穴道观瞬间消失了，一间明亮干净，空气清新的病房出现他的面前，而他的下半身则被布带死死的束缚在床上。
content_en:
Li Huowang raised the medicine tampering rod in his hand and smashed it into the medicine tampering jar out of boredom, slowly grinding the flowing bluestone mixed with silt into powder.
Although the cave was damp and cold, the boy was only wearing a rough cloth. But he looked indifferent and didn't seem to take it all seriously.
He was not the only one in the cave, there were also other men and women of similar age, with the same hair tied in the same coarse cloth and hemp rope.
The only difference between them and Li Huowang is that they all have obvious physical defects, including albinism and polio.
All kinds of congenital and acquired physical deformities can be found here. The small cave is like a museum of deformities.
The job of these people is the same as Li Huowang's, except that the things they pound are different. There are gold stones and medicines. But it is obvious that some people do not feel at ease in their work.
"Ah!" A woman screamed in horror, causing everyone to look.
On the side of the cave, a fat boy with hare lips showed a lewd smile, trying to pull an albino girl into his arms.
"I'll just do it, I promise, hey hey~"
Li Huowang ignored the noise, closed his eyes and continued to work step by step.
Listening to the woman's cries becoming more and more pitiful, the annoyed Li Huowang cursed secretly, picked up the stone medicine jar with one hand and stood up.
"Duo" the stone hit the bones together, making a muffled sound.
The fat man with a cleft lip, whose head was bleeding and bleeding, sat on the ground and was stunned. He was obviously stunned by the blow. After two seconds, his expression was distorted and painful, and he screamed while covering his wound.
The white-haired and fair-skinned girl who escaped the tainted fate covered her clothes and hid behind Li Huowang in fear.
"I'm telling you! If you're done flirting, do you know what a benevolent master I am? If he finds out about flirting, he'll kill you!" The fat man with the cleft lip threatened with an extremely angry expression.
"Who the hell is he? He's not even a shit!!" As soon as Li Huowang said these words, the entire audience fell silent in shock.
Others present never thought that the man in front of them would dare to say such a thing.
Looking at the expressions of the so-called brothers and sisters in front of him, Li Huowang took a deep breath and suppressed the anger in his heart.
"What's wrong with me? Why am I angry with these things? My personality is obviously not so flamboyant. I can't let these things affect my personality. The person I was just now is not the real me. Stay calm and collected."
Just when Li Huowang was still calming down, he heard someone calling him at the door.
"Junior Brother Li, Junior Sister Wang, the master has called you to wait here." The tall young man calling was obviously of a different status from Li Huowang. He was wearing a cyan Taoist robe.
Although the robe looked very old and the cuffs were washed white, it was infinitely better than the tattered linen cloth Li Huowang wore.
This man held a ponytail whisk with one hand and looked at the juniors in front of him with a hint of arrogance in his eyes.
Seeing the young Taoist priest appear, the fat man with a bloody head and a bloody head suddenly showed an expression of joy in his misfortune. "Haha! You're done teasing!! It's your day to tease."
But Li Huowang ignored him completely and turned around to follow a woman with a crooked mouth and drooling water towards the door. The woman's face was pale and looked very unhealthy.
After taking just two steps, he found someone tugging on his sleeve, holding him back to prevent him from leaving. Li Huowang turned around and found that it was the albino girl who was saved by him.
With tears in her eyes, she kept shaking her head, her eyes filled with fear.
The indifferent Li Huowang remained unmoved. He threw down his sleeves and strode forward.
Coming out of the material room is a larger cave. There are many caves on the cave wall that are similar to the material room and are used for other purposes. Judging from the pits and pits, it is obvious that the craftsmanship of the people who built this place was not very good.
The entire cave is very large, with tunnels of all sizes extending in all directions., like an enlarged version of an anthill.
Pieces of decayed peach wood were nailed to each small cave knot, and the name of each cave was carved on it with three-thirds of force, such as Linggong Palace, Laolutang Hall, Qingzu Hall, and Siyu Hall.
A naturally formed cave was actually decorated to look like a Taoist temple.
Just as the two of them continued walking along the cave, the woman with a crooked mouth next to them took out a dark object from her pocket, suddenly handed it to Li Huowang, and said in a dazed voice: "Would you like... thin candy?"
Li Huowang frowned slightly, as if he knew the other party's stupidity, and impatiently came over and stuffed it into his sleeve.
Seeing Li Huowang take it, she took out another piece from her pocket and stuffed it into her mouth, and continued stupidly: "Hello, master... I can have some sweets with the master..."
Li Huowang didn't intend to say anything about this. The two of them continued to walk like this for about a quarter of an hour when a tall, antique-looking, black alchemy furnace appeared in front of him.
The smoke-belching furnace cauldron poked straight into the roof of the cave, and the alchemy furnace was so huge that it looked like a metal hill.
From far to near, he watched the alchemy furnace gradually grow in size, and finally the shadow of the alchemy furnace directly overwhelmed him, which made Li Huowang feel even more depressed.
What made him feel depressed was not only the huge five-story alchemy furnace, but also a silhouette in front of the alchemy furnace.
Seen from the back, he is wearing a blue Taoist robe, with a hairpin and a crown, and white hair on his temples. He looks very immortal.
Sitting cross-legged on the ground, he seemed to be doing the same thing as Li Huowang before. He took the medicine tampering rod and pounded it, but the medicine tampering rod in his hand was obviously much larger and looked like a giant pillar.
As they fell together, the sound of the collision of gold and stone continued to echo in the cave.
"Master...Master!" The woman with a slanted mouth clumsily pinched the thumb of her left hand with her right hand, placed the four fingers of her left hand on top of the fingers of her right hand, put her hands on her chest and bowed to the back, her eyes full of respect.
As soon as she spoke, the harsh crashing sound stopped.
As soon as his back turned, Li Huowang's pupils shrank slightly in shock, even though he had been prepared in his heart.
The front of the Taoist priest is completely different from the back. From the back, you can see the immortal Taoist bones, but from the front, it looks like a disgusting old man with a leprosy. A few scattered yellow teeth in Di Baotian's mouth are exposed in the air.
"Here you come? My dear disciple, please let me wait."
With a wave of his dirty Taoist robe, the old Taoist priest rose into the air, grabbed the crooked-mouthed woman's neck with one hand and retreated.
Before the stupid woman could say another sentence, she was instantly thrown into a stone jar half as tall as a person. The next moment, the master with a ferocious expression hit her head hard with a stone medicine stick the size of his fist.
As the screams suddenly stopped, a certain sound of feet stepping into the mud came from the stone urn.
This was not over yet. The previous impact echoed again, and as the poisoning rod was raised high and dropped heavily, every part of the woman's body ended up like her head.
With each knock, the skin and flesh of Li Huowang's right cheek, who was breathing rapidly, trembled violently.
Meat residue and blood spattered on the old Taoist priest's face and body, but he remained unmoved and excitedly chanted something to a certain melody.
"Ding Chou prolongs my life, Ding Hai protects my soul, Jia Zi protects my body, Jia Xu protects my shape, Jia Shen secures my life, Jia Wu protects my soul, Jia Chen is my soul!"
When it was completely smashed into pulp, he lifted the stone weighing several hundred kilograms with one hand, poured all the mud into the alchemy furnace in front of him, and then raised his hands into the air with an extremely excited expression.
"Start the furnace and make the elixir!"
Two Taoist boys with exaggerated blush makeup walked out of the shadows, fanning themselves while pouring various condiments into the alchemy furnace, including various gold and stone powders and many living and wriggling things.
After a while, a strangely rich aroma filled the air.
At this moment, the mangy-headed master closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and stroked the few beards on his chin, with a satisfied expression on his dirty and ugly face.
When he slowly opened his eyes, he put his hands behind his back and turned to look at Li Huowang. "I heard that you called me a bastard? Is this true?"
In an instant, the surrounding air seemed to solidify.
Looking at the murderous so-called master in front of him, Li Huowang remained unmoved. He slowly closed his eyes to calm down his rapid breathing, and said silently in his heart: "You can't deceive me. This is all fake. It's all fake."
"Speak! Are you mute? Huh?!" As the sound of the master's footsteps got closer and closer, the stench of his body mixed with the smell of blood hit his nostrils like a wall.
The trembling Li Huowang gritted his teeth and used all his strength to open his eyes.
The cave Taoist temple that was dark and depressing just now disappeared in an instant, and a bright, clean, and fresh-air ward appeared in front of him, and his lower body was tightly bound to the bed with a cloth belt.
